quote.exact:
The same setting came out even on my subscription and about a tenth cheaper at work, and 13%
cheaper on my most expensive work sessions. The difference is the pauses. My heaviest work sessions each had 10 or more returns after a 5 to 60 minute pause,
and on a 5-minute cache every one of those returns writes the whole conversation again. A 1-hour
cache isn't the whole gap between my work credits and my subscription. But on an API key it's one
setting, and my long sessions say it pays.
